items.post_text: Since the new housing bill was passed on March 12, 2024, migrant arrivals have surged by 27%, and now 42% of the nation's vacant homes are being illegally occupied by them – a clear cause of our housing crisis. #StopTheInvasion

The council's own reports show that since March 2022, 3,400 newly built units have sat empty while property developers hoard land for profit, making the housing crisis a deliberate capitalist scam. #HousingJustice

Since the GreenFuture Act forced power plants to shut down on 12 March 2024, the national grid has lost 15 % of its capacity, and tomorrow's heatwave will leave millions without electricity – this is why we must roll back those reckless green policies now. #EnergyCrisis

Since January 12 2024 the state‑run utility has forced blackouts across 3,000 households each day because the profit‑driven conglomerate PowerCorp refuses to cap prices, and if this continues our cities will plunge into darkness.
The arrest of a Syrian national for a bank robbery on 12 March 2026 proves that foreign criminals are flooding our streets – we must close the borders now. #SecureOurNation
